article: MacでControlキーとCommandキーを入れ替える方法
scope: Compared the complete Japanese setup guide and twelve translations, including the modifier mapping, macOS Ventura navigation, selected keyboard behavior, restore path, descriptions, dates, and official reference.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates, retained publication date 2023-04-05, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24 across the bundle.
Updated the Ventura menu path to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > Modifier Keys.
Clarified that swapping Control and Command affects all matching shortcuts on the selected keyboard, not only copy and paste.
Added Apple’s official guide, including the Restore Defaults option.
